name: Mail Delivery Failed
description: A notification email could not be delivered. Verify SMTP host, port, and credentials, and allow-list the sender address.
match_patterns: ["smtp", "javax\\.mail", "mailconnect"]

name: OAuth Token Request Failed
description: The identity provider rejected the client-credentials or token exchange request. Verify the OAuth client credentials and granted scopes in the destination, then re-issue the secret if it has expired.
match_patterns: ["invalid_request", "invalid_client", "invalid_scope", "unsupported_grant_type", "missing grant type", "bad credentials", "access token not found", "token request failed", "oauth2_provider_success_status_code", "/oauth2?/token"]

name: Credential Rejected
description: The target system refused the supplied user name, password, or key. Confirm the service account is unlocked and the stored credential matches the target system.
match_patterns: ["logon_failure", "jco_error_logon_failure", "name or password is incorrect", "auth fail for methods", "authentication rejected", "authentication required", "authentication failed for", "no authentication mechanisms"]

name: Unauthorized Request
description: The request reached the target but carried no valid authentication context. Check that the calling flow attaches credentials and that the token has not expired.
match_patterns: ["http_401", "unauthorized", "error in retrieving authorization header", "status code:<n>; reason:forbidden"]

name: Principal Propagation Failed
description: The runtime could not forward the caller identity to the backend. Enable principal propagation on the destination and confirm the user exists in the target tenant.
match_patterns: ["principaltoken", "getsamltoken", "could not find any user to be propagated", "unable to map .* to a valid bizx user"]

name: Access Denied
description: The identity authenticated successfully but lacks permission for the operation. Grant the required role or object permission to the integration service account.
match_patterns: ["forbidden", "no permission", "insufficient permissions", "no_permissions_exception", "access denied", "not authorized to", "access permission for"]

name: Keystore Entry Missing
description: A key pair or certificate alias referenced by the flow is absent from the keystore. Deploy the missing key pair under the exact alias the flow references.
match_patterns: ["no key pair found for alias", "keystoreservice"]

name: TLS Trust Validation Failed
description: Certificate, signature, or WS-Security validation failed during the handshake or message check. Renew or re-import the certificate chain and confirm the security policy matches the partner contract.
match_patterns: ["<cert>", "not verified", "signature or decryption was invalid", "no ws-security header", "policy alternatives can not be satisfied", "xmlsignatureformat", "fatal alert", "pgpexception"]

name: DNS Resolution Failed
description: The target hostname could not be resolved. Verify the endpoint hostname and that it resolves from the runtime network.
match_patterns: ["name or service not known", "unknownhostexception"]

name: Connection Timeout
description: The target did not respond within the configured timeout. Check backend health and response times, then tune the timeout if the backend is legitimately slow.
match_patterns: ["timeout", "timed out"]

name: Connection Refused
description: The TCP connection was refused or dropped by the peer or an intermediary. Confirm the service is listening and that firewall and proxy rules allow the route.
match_patterns: ["connection refused", "connection reset", "broken pipe", "failed to connect", "network_unreachable", "socks5", "socketexception"]

name: Cloud Connector Unavailable
description: The on-premise tunnel could not be used for this call. Check Cloud Connector status and expose the required host or function module for that location id.
match_patterns: ["cloud connector", "scc_version", "location id", "lg group not found", "expose the function module", "opening connection to back-end system failed"]

name: File Write Failed
description: The file could not be written to the target directory. Create the target directory and grant write permission to the transfer account.
match_patterns: ["cannot store file", "should exists relative to", "write access to the folder", "rename file operation failed", "read operation failed"]

name: SFTP Host Key Untrusted
description: The SFTP server host key is unknown or changed since it was last trusted. Re-import the current host key into the known-hosts store after verifying the fingerprint.
match_patterns: ["hostkey", "known_?hosts"]

name: SFTP Connection Failed
description: The file-transfer session to the SFTP or SMB server could not be established. Verify server reachability, credentials, and that the runtime egress IPs are allow-listed.
match_patterns: ["sftp", "smbexception", "session connect", "on-premise connection failed"]

name: Upstream Service Unavailable
description: The upstream service returned an unavailable or maintenance response. Retry after the maintenance window and align the schedule with the provider status page.
match_patterns: ["service unavailable", "errorinfo_upstream", "down for maintenance"]

name: Client Request Aborted
description: The caller disconnected before the response was written. Align the caller timeout with observed processing time; safe to ignore if isolated.
match_patterns: ["errorinfo_client_closed_request", "client closed request", "attempted read from closed stream", "error during write of the response"]

name: HTTP Redirect Unresolved
description: The endpoint answered with a redirect the flow did not follow. Point the flow at the API endpoint rather than the UI URL and attach credentials.
match_patterns: ["redirectlocation", "invalid_login_request", "response state text: found"]

name: HTTP Request Failed
description: An outbound HTTP call returned a non-success status. Inspect the returned status and body, then confirm the endpoint path and API version.
match_patterns: ["http operation failed invoking", "httpoperationfailed", "ahcoperationfailed", "http error response code", "http request failed", "with statuscode", "edmx fetch failed", "http response code", ": <n> : http/<n>", "unexpected text/html contenttype"]

name: SOAP Fault Returned
description: The SOAP service answered with a fault instead of a business response. Read the fault code and message, then correct the request payload or query syntax.
match_patterns: ["soapfault", "soap faultcode", "faultstring", "sfapi domain error", "wsclientfaultexception", "invalid_sfql", "date_exceeds_restriction", "cxf.interceptor.fault"]

name: Job Execution Failed
description: The job or integration run ended in a failed state without a more specific cause. Open the run log for the failing step to get the underlying error.
match_patterns: ["job failed", "integration failed", "has failed", "error event exception", "errorevent", "failed$", "data changed by trigger", "errors found in", "exception occurred during execution", "click text to download"]

name: Run Diagnostic Event
description: An informational run event captured alongside the failure payload. No action required; useful as timeline context around the real failure.
match_patterns: ["summary_so_far", "- start$", "- event - ", "records read in", "records processing completed", "read access logging", "successfully generated authentication token", "successfully read file", "number of source pages written", "successfully updated", "failed <n> times repeatedly"]

name: Unclassified Error
description: No family pattern matched this failure yet. Review the message and add a family pattern so it groups correctly next time.
